What is a dynamic QR code?

A code whose destination lives on the server side instead of inside the pattern. The printed code stays the same, but you can change where it points after printing — and see how many times it was scanned.
How is it different from a static code?

A static code carries its content inside the pattern: free, no sign-up, made in your browser, and it can never change. A dynamic code needs a free sign-in, but you can edit its destination and track scans. Both never expire.
How many dynamic codes are free?
20 on the free plan — and right now, during the limited-time offer, unlimited for everyone. Pro is unlimited, always.
Do dynamic codes expire?
No. Dynamic codes never expire. If you stop using one, repoint it to your next campaign instead of reprinting — the poster keeps working.
